description: An RGB-TIR Dataset from UAV Platform for Robust Urban Traffic Scenes Semantic Segmentation is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Junlin Ouyang et al. We introduce Kust4K, a UAV-based dataset for RGB-TIR multimodal semantic segmentation. Kust4K dataset is designed to overcome key limitations in existing UAV-based semantic segmentation datasets: low information density, limited data volume, and insufficient robustness discussion under non-ideal environment. Kust4K dataset featuring 4,024 of 640 × 512 pixel-aligned RGB-Thermal Infrared image pairs captured across diverse urban road scenes under variable illumination. Coverage: not stated; published in 2025. Formats: Image. The data are held in Figshare and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 2780861788 Bytes. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
